integrity: Proof is algebraic; standalone enumerator is finite corroboration and not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for monic quadratic moduli over finite fields and canonical degree-less-than-two representatives. Not a classification for higher degrees. Unindexed previous derivations cannot be entirely ruled out. No independent audit.
title: Prime-polynomial subgroups of every quadratic finite-field modulus: exact order profiles and a characteristic-parity transition
